classification_basis: Author-approved LICENSE.md and reviewed path classifications for the pinned PC1 scientific contents as distributed in version 1.0.0.

author_code.label: Original source code, tests, schemas and execution configuration
author_code.scope: Only original source and implementation/configuration contributions for which Antonio Clim holds the relevant rights; dependencies and separately licensed fragments retain their own terms.

author_documentation.label: Original software and research-protocol documentation
author_documentation.scope: Only original authored expression, structure and commentary. Source facts, quotations and separately licensed material are not relicensed.

author_figures.label: Original figure contributions and editable/exported representations
author_figures.scope: Only original drawing, layout, explanatory and presentation contributions within the author's rights. Source/provider facts and separately licensed material retain their status.

author_aggregate_results.label: Approved original aggregate-result and derived-table contributions
author_aggregate_results.scope: Only original authored presentation, arrangement and commentary in the approved aggregate outputs; no exclusive rights are asserted over numbers, source facts or underlying provider material. This does not cover microdata or withheld outputs.

openalex_provider_material.label: Retained raw OpenAlex provider responses and metadata
openalex_provider_material.retained_upstream_terms: CC0-1.0 as recorded for the retained provider material
openalex_provider_material.scope: Provider material remains under its recorded upstream terms; the author does not relicense it. Metadata terms do not convey rights in indexed article full texts.

mixed_provenance.label: Acquisition, normalisation, provider/source facts and mixed-provenance records
mixed_provenance.author_grant: CC-BY-4.0 only for original authored structure or commentary
mixed_provenance.scope: No blanket author grant over the file. Source facts, provider material, quotations and separately licensed content retain their status. Factual source routes grant no rights in the catalogue or dataset they identify.

world_bank_source.label: Seven retained original World Bank Stata source files
world_bank_source.scope: The exact retained World Bank source notice governs this component. No MIT or CC BY author grant is applied; the source notice does not license controlled FAT microdata.

world_bank_notice.label: Retained original World Bank copyright and licence notice
world_bank_notice.scope: Retained source notice, without correction or substitution. No author-owned copyright grant is asserted over this text.

historical_evidence.label: Historical manifests, execution/audit receipts, diagnostics and provenance ledgers
historical_evidence.author_grant: CC-BY-4.0 only for original authored structure or commentary
historical_evidence.scope: Recorded hashes, run facts and historical states remain factual evidence. Original authored structure/commentary is covered only within the author's rights; quoted/provider/dependency material retains its status. Earlier proposed-licence and unpublished-status statements remain historical, not current grants.

current_distribution_metadata.label: Current distribution identification, rights mapping and integrity indices
current_distribution_metadata.author_grant: CC-BY-4.0 only for original authored structure or commentary
current_distribution_metadata.scope: Original authored metadata presentation is covered within the author's rights. Names, identifiers, hashes and source facts are not given new exclusive rights. Rights statements describe the approved scope rather than enlarging it.

standard_licence_text.label: Reproduced standard licence legal text
standard_licence_text.scope: No author-owned copyright grant is asserted over the standard licence legal text itself. The licence governs identified contributions, not ownership of the legal text.

mixed_component_archive.label: Container of separately scoped scientific components
mixed_component_archive.scope: No blanket archive licence. Consult every member's explicit classification in RIGHTS_INVENTORY.json and the applicable original notices.

integrity_design: Path classifications do not contain per-file hashes or self hashes. The distribution manifest binds outer bytes; the unchanged inner manifest binds scientific member bytes. This avoids circular self-hashes.
